test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: At what annual interest rate will a certain sum double itself in 2 years, if interest is calculated on annual compounding basis? [Answer rounded off to one decimal place.]
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹X

Amount (A) = ₹2X

Time (t) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P × (1 + r/100)t

Where,

P = Principal

A = Amount

r = Rate of interest

t = Time in years

**Calculations:**

2X = X × (1 + r/100)²

⇒ 2 = (1 + r/100)²

⇒ √2 = 1 + r/100

⇒ r/100 = √2 - 1

⇒ r = (√2 - 1) × 100

⇒ r ≈ (1.414 - 1) × 100

⇒ r ≈ 0.414 × 100

⇒ r ≈ 41.4%

**∴ The required interest rate is approximately 41.4% per annum.**

70:T
